en.headline: Nine injured as two KMB double-deckers collide in Tuen Mun
en.dek: A route 258D bus struck the rear of a route 66M bus near Shan King Estate on Ming Kum Road shortly after 8am, with both drivers among the casualties.
body: Nine people, including two drivers, were injured when two Kowloon Motor Bus double-deckers collided in Tuen Mun on Thursday morning.

The collision occurred around 8.15am near King Yip House at Shan King Estate on Ming Kum Road. A red route 258D bus travelling towards Po Tin Estate struck the rear of a gold-coloured route 66M bus that was stopped at traffic lights.

Four men and five women sustained minor injuries and were taken to Tuen Mun Hospital. KMB said it had suspended the driving duties of one of the drivers involved. Police are investigating the cause of the accident, which briefly disrupted traffic on the road.
Photographs from the scene showed damage to the front of the red bus, including a shattered windscreen, and damage to the rear of the gold bus.

zh.headline: 屯門兩九巴相撞九人受傷
zh.dek: 早上約8時15分，258D線紅色九巴在鳴琴路山景邨對開撞向停在燈位的66M線金色九巴車尾，兩名車長在內共九人輕傷。
body: 周四早上屯門發生兩輛九巴相撞意外，九人受傷，包括兩名車長。
意外發生在約上午8時15分，鳴琴路近山景邨景業樓。一輛往寶田邨方向的紅色258D線雙層巴士，從後撞向前方停在交通燈位的金色66M線巴士。
四男五女輕傷，由救護車送往屯門醫院治理。九巴表示已暫停其中一名涉事車長的駕駛職務。警方正調查意外原因，現場一度封路造成交通擠塞。
現場照片顯示紅色巴士車頭及擋風玻璃受損，金色巴士車尾亦凹陷。
